da-false-claim.notes: Main claim Φ_8(X)=Φ_4(X²) i.e. X⁴+1=(X²+1)∘X² is a true textbook identity; the refuted strand-doubling *categorical* hypothesis is explicitly flagged REFUTED in the .md, not stated as a live claim.

da-vacuous.notes: The proposition is a genuine algebraic identity with a real proof; not content-free.

da-overclaim.notes: The general 'powers-of-two strand-doubling' theorem Φ_{2^{k+1}}=Φ_{2^k}∘X² is stated with sorry and its docstring presents the powers-of-two cyclotomic tower as a real 'structural pattern hypothesised for atomic-step pairs' — the very tower the .md (lines 76-88) marks REFUTED. The pure algebraic identity is actually true for k≥1 (since 2|2^k), but the docstring over-attaches the falsified physical interpretation. Not block-level (lean.ref targets only the valid main theorem).

da-hidden-dof.notes: No free parameter; pure ℤ[X] identity. The Φ_8² empirical prefactor is honestly labeled 'mechanism OPEN'.

da-non-sequitur.notes: Proof (Φ_4=X²+1, Φ_8=X⁴+1, compose) is a valid 3-step computation.

da-lean-narrative-divergence.evidence: cyclotomic-strand-doubling.lean:62-69 docstring of cyclotomic_8_eq_cyclotomic_4_comp_X_sq vs cyclotomic-strand-doubling.md:68-88
da-lean-narrative-divergence.notes: The Lean docstring of the lean.ref target asserts the refuted interpretation as live fact: 'The substitution X → X² is the strand-doubling map lifting B_2 (2-strand single nucleon) to B_4 (4-strand deuteron, 2 nucleons × 2 isospin channels)' and calls the identity 'load-bearing ... for the categorical interpretation of Φ_8²'. The .md (Historical note, lines 68-88) declares exactly this strand-doubling categorical hypothesis FALSE. The Lean statement proved (the algebraic identity) is correct and weaker-than-narrative is not the issue; the issue is the docstring carries a falsified categorical claim the .md retracts — a stale Lean/narrative divergence the QA reader will hit. Likewise cyclotomic_8_irreducible docstring (lines 139-142) restates the Φ_8² 'multiplicity-2 structural' reading without the OPEN/REFUTED caveat.

da-citation-misuse.notes: cites habiro2000 (DOI 10.2140/gt.2000.4.227 = 'colored Jones of simple links') for Habiro-RING / cyclotomic-integrality content. references.ts notes (lines 1676,1706) explicitly state QOU citers intending the Habiro ring Ẑ[q] (q-Pochhammer/cyclotomic completion) 'were re-keyed to habiro2004cyclotomic' — habiro2000 does not contain the cyclotomic-ring/integrality result invoked here.
